steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Durkheim (1858-1917): founding figure of sociology. Key ideas: social facts (external forces that constrain behaviour - laws, norms, religion), collective conscience (shared beliefs and values binding society together), anomie (normlessness when social regulation breaks down). Studied suicide rates to show social factors influence even the most personal act. | Key Fact: Marx (1818-1883): society is shaped by class conflict. Key ideas: historical materialism (economy shapes society), alienation (workers are disconnected from their labour under capitalism - they don't own what they produce), false consciousness (workers don't realise they are exploited), revolution (the proletariat will overthrow capitalism creating a classless society). | Key Fact: Weber (1864-1920): society canno
